Class JsonDocument

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.JsonDocument
public final class JsonDocument extends Object

A parsed document: its root value, and where each of its values is written.

The root and the objects and arrays it holds are lazy: their values are created on their first access. The document keeps its bytes and its index in memory, to create them and to compute positions.

Since:
0.1.0

      Returns where an element of an array starts.
